description: Is it legal to send a cold or marketing email to this person? Check before the first email to any new lead, prospect or contact who is not already a customer, one call per address: a compliance check for B2B sales outreach, prospecting and lead lists. Whether it is allowed, or needs consent first, turns on facts you cannot see in the address, such as whether a UK recipient is a limited company or a sole trader, so it looks them up live (UK Companies House) and applies UK PECR and GDPR, US CAN-SPAM, Canadian CASL, German UWG, French CPCE, Australia's Spam Act, Ireland's ePrivacy Regulations and the Dutch Telecommunicatiewet. Returns a verdict (ok_to_email, consent_needed, blocked or unknown), the rule quoted with its source, the footer requirements (who you are, a postal address, an unsubscribe or opt-out), the next step and a signed receipt id to show a client or auditor. Each call uses one check from your allowance (free daily allowance, no sign-in) and sends nothing to the recipient. Not for transactional emails such as invoices, receipts or password resets.

address_source.description: Where the address came from: published (on their website, profile or a directory), bought (a purchased list), scraped (collected by a tool), given (the person gave it to you) or unknown. It affects the verdict, so do not assume published. Default unknown.

company_number.description: UK company number if known (8 characters), so the register can confirm the company.

default_recipient_country.description: Two-letter country code to use only when the recipient's country can't be worked out from recipient_country, the domain, company records or the company's website, for example US if all your prospects are in the US. recipient_country always wins.

existing_customer.description: True if the recipient has bought from you before. Default false.

pitch.description: What the email offers, in a few words, for example 'bookkeeping software for dental practices'. Used to judge relevance to the recipient's role.

pitch_relevant.description: True if the pitch relates to the recipient's job or business, false if it does not.

recipient_country.description: Two-letter country code of the recipient if known, for example GB or DE. Otherwise it is worked out from the domain, company records and the company's website.

recipient_domain.description: The recipient's domain when you have no email address, for example acme.co.uk.

recipient_email.description: The recipient's email address. Give this or recipient_domain.

sender_country.description: Country the sending business is based in, GB or US. Not the recipient's country. Default GB.

suppressed.description: True if the recipient is on your own do-not-contact list.

name: contact_check

footer_text.description: What the email's footer must include, if the rule sets requirements.

reasons.description: The rule that matched, with its text and source, then any notes.

rules_version.description: Version of the rule set used.

title: Cold email compliance check
